entities.name: Scarmaker
entities.description: A kami of Kamigawa, formerly a human warrior, who betrayed the humans and became a kami during the Kami War.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The war in which Scarmaker was active.

events.summary: Scarmaker, a human hired warrior, betrayed the humans, joined the kami and became one.
events.quote: but betrayed the humans, joining the side of the kami and turning into one himself
